meta.title: The Seed That Waited Twenty Years
meta.logline: My parents told me how my grandmother Tiseme kept planting one warka seed through failed seedlings, hungry goats and gentle laughter, and years after she was gone it became a tree for her grandchildren.
meta.audience: My family and relatives, watching on their phones (vertical first) and forwarding it in family chats.
meta.intent: They should feel quiet pride and patience: that what we plant for others can outlive us, and that her persistence still shelters us.

shots.reason: Establish the place, the woman and the seed in one picture; the dream is introduced here.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot at dawn, a small elderly woman walking a dirt path toward a round thatched house, holding a single tiny seed in her open palm, long soft shadows, mist over distant hills
shots.motion_prompt: Camera slowly pushes in, mist drifts across the hills, her shawl moves gently in the breeze.
shots.narration: ወላጆቼ ስለ አያቴ ትሰሜ ነገሩኝ። ዘር ሁሉ ህልም ይሸከማል ብላ ታምን ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: My parents told me about my grandmother Tiseme. She believed every seed carries a dream.

shots.reason: The first act of hope: a close detail of hands, which keeps the face out of frame and is easy to keep consistent.
shots.image_prompt: Close view of weathered hands pressing a seed into bare red-brown soil beside a stone wall, no plant or sprout visible, white shawl sleeve visible
shots.motion_prompt: Static camera, soil is brushed gently over the seed, soft dust in the light.
shots.narration: አንድ ማለዳ ዘር ይዛ መጣች፤ ከቤቷ አጠገብ ተከለችው። ምንም አልበቀለም።
shots.subtitle_en: One morning she brought a seed home and planted it beside her house. Nothing came up.

shots.reason: Her first real setback, with no single villain: she does everything right, waters it every day, and it still fails. Shows her care and that effort alone does not guarantee a result.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of the grandmother carefully pouring water from a clay jug onto a small drooping seedling in a garden beside her house, damp dark soil, soft morning light
shots.motion_prompt: Camera holds steady, water pours slowly, the seedling droops slightly.
shots.narration: በየቀኑ ታጠጣው ነበር፤ ሆኖም በተለያዩ ምክንያቶች ቡቃያው ጠፋ።
shots.subtitle_en: She watered it every day, but for many different reasons, the seedling was lost.

shots.reason: Second failure, a different cause (goats), so the middle does not feel repetitive; she watches and does not give up.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of goats crowding around a young plant in a small garden by a stone wall, the grandmother standing behind them with her hands lowered
shots.motion_prompt: Camera holds steady, goats move slowly, her shawl stirs in the wind.
shots.narration: በቀጣዩ ዓመት ፍየሎች ቡቃያውን በሉት። እሷ ግን እንደገና ተከለች።
shots.subtitle_en: The year after, the goats ate it. She planted again.

shots.reason: The emotional turn: persistence in the face of gentle mockery. Held for 9 seconds because this is the heart of the middle.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of the grandmother kneeling to press a seed into bare soil, no sprout visible, two villagers standing at a distance smiling kindly, round houses behind, warm afternoon light
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan right across the villagers to the grandmother, gentle breeze.
shots.narration: ወቅት ከወቅት፣ ያንኑ ዘር ትተክል ነበር። የመንደሩ ሰዎች በቀስታ ይስቁባት ነበር። እሷ ግን መትከሏን አላቆመችም።
shots.subtitle_en: Season after season, she planted the same seed. The villagers laughed, gently. She kept planting.

shots.reason: Her one spoken belief, the thesis of the film, on the closest shot of her; held longest.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close view of the elderly grandmother, thin and tired, kneeling and pressing one tiny seed into bare brown soil with her fingertips, no plant and no sprout anywhere, only bare earth, golden evening light, face turned downward, full-bleed painting filling the entire frame, no border, no signature
shots.motion_prompt: Very slow push-in, soft light flicker, camera otherwise still.
shots.narration: ስትደክም የመጨረሻውን ዘር ተከለች። 'ዘር አይረሳም፤ እኔ ባላየውም አንድ ቀን ያድጋል' አለች።
shots.subtitle_en: Old and tired, she planted one last seed. 'A seed does not forget,' she said. 'One day it will grow, even if I am not here to see it.'

shots.reason: Her absence, shown by an empty garden. The quietest shot gives the audience a pause before the turn.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of an empty overgrown garden beside a quiet small round house at dusk, bare soil and dry grass, nobody in sight
shots.motion_prompt: Static camera, grass sways slightly, the light fades slowly.
shots.narration: ከዚያ አረፈች። የአትክልት ቦታዋ ዝም አለ፤ ሰውም ረሳው።
shots.subtitle_en: Then she passed away. Her garden grew quiet, and people forgot it.

shots.reason: The payoff begins: the first sign of life, in extreme close detail, after the quietest moment.
shots.image_prompt: Close view of a tiny bright green shoot breaking through dark soil, raindrops falling, soft grey rain light
shots.motion_prompt: Static camera, rain falls, the shoot sways slightly.
shots.narration: ወቅቶች ግን ይፈራረቁ ነበር። አንድ ማለዳም፣ አረንጓዴ ቡቃያ ብቅ አለ።
shots.subtitle_en: But the seasons kept turning. And one morning, a green shoot appeared.

shots.reason: The reveal: the scale of the great tree where only a small shoot was, with her grandchildren in its shade.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of a magnificent huge spreading warka fig tree with a wide dark-green canopy beside a small highland house, golden light, two small children playing beneath it seen from behind
shots.motion_prompt: Slow upward tilt along the trunk to the canopy, leaves move gently.
shots.narration: ከሃያ ዓመት በኋላ፣ እሷ ትሠራበት በነበረው ቦታ ግዙፍ ዋርካ ቆሟል።
shots.subtitle_en: Twenty years later, a great warka tree stands where she worked.

shots.reason: Joy before the close: the grandchildren playing under the tree she planted, so the audience feels what the waiting bought.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of several small children laughing and playing tag in the dappled shade under a huge spreading warka fig tree, thick roots and trunk beside them, golden evening light, joyful movement
shots.motion_prompt: Camera holds steady, the children run and laugh, leaves and dappled light move gently.
shots.narration: እኛ የልጅ ልጆቿ በጥላው ሥር እንጫወታለን።
shots.subtitle_en: We, her grandchildren, play in its shade.

shots.reason: Closes the loop: the story passes from her to my mother to me. The memory cloud shows Grandmother planting, so the film ends on her, not on us.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot in the shade of a huge warka tree: a small child looks up at his mother, who sits smiling and gazing upward; above the mother's head floats a small soft watercolour memory cloud containing a tiny painted scene of an elderly grandmother in a white shawl kneeling to plant a seed beside a stone wall; thick tree trunk behind them, warm evening light
shots.motion_prompt: Camera holds steady, the memory cloud glows softly and drifts slightly, the mother's scarf moves in the breeze.
shots.narration: ማን እንደተከለው እናቴን ጠየቅኳት። ፈገግ አለችና፣ ስለ አያቴ፣ ሃያ ዓመት ስለጠበቀው ዘር ነገረችኝ።
shots.subtitle_en: I asked my mother who planted it. She smiled and told me about my grandmother, and the seed that waited twenty years.
